findings.summary: a Standard `material.plugins` write emitted a call to `set_material_plugins` while the definition and its translation unit were gated on the opt-in feature, so a scene attaching plugins without `enableMaterialPlugins` would not link — upstream has two facts there and this port had collapsed them onto one; the write now reaches its own `material:plugin-index` while the opt-in keeps registering the bridges

the emitted Standard derivation masked the signature index where the pin's own bake does not (it masks on read-back), and the doc claimed a mask assertion that did not exist; the line is now the pin's unmasked OR, its shape asserted against `registerStdPlugins` through `pinnedPluginBakeShift`, with the index bound checked once at registration instead of per draw

`Value.standardMaterial` answered the material-family question only on a `createStandardMaterial` result and joined neither propagation path, so `box.material.plugins = [...]` refused wrongly; it now rides the mesh assignment and the `mesh.material` read beside `scenePbrMaterialIndex`

the composed plugin list travelled to composition as a JSON key that was re-stringified to recover an index the caller already held; the Standard input carries the compiler's own 1-based index and the bridge registration returns bits by position

`standardPluginIndexShift` and `standardPluginIndexMask` hand-parsed a pinned constant twice; both now go through `LoweringContext.numericValue` over `variableInitializer`, the spelling `camera-lowerer.ts` already uses, which also removes the import cycle a `pinnedNumericConstant` import would have created

the pinned injection-point tables were read with hand-rolled object-literal and guarded-walk code; `LoweringContext.objectInitializer` (its parameter widened to `ts.Node`), `propertyName`, `findNodes` and `contractError` replace all four spellings

the plugin fold re-implemented the static array probe and the string/template literal fold; `probeStaticArrayLiteral` and `compileStaticString` replace both, the latter a strict superset that also accepts a const binding and a literal concatenation

the plugin member name was read as an identifier in one place and through the full property-name rule in another, so a string-keyed `getUniforms` skipped its own by-name refusal; both now use `propertyName`

`importPinnedModule` rebuilt the library root join and the file URL on every call, which the material derivation makes once per material; memoizing it the way `importPinnedModuleWithExports` already memoizes its augmented imports measured 7.9x on `pinnedStandardRenderableFeatures`
`composeSceneStandardVariants` walked `materialInputs` twice with the same call to build a value list and a representative map; the map's own key order is that list, so the second walk is gone
the sweep's new plugin arm reindented an invariant object literal into a seventh loop level; the literal is hoisted and the arm spreads it
`resetMaterialPluginBridges` had no caller anywhere in the repository
`onlyReturn` took a context parameter it discarded with a `void` statement
`standardPluginFeatureBits` returned zero silently for an unregistered list on one branch and threw a named error for the same fact on another; one path remains
the recorder re-stringified every stored plugin list on every lookup; it keys a Map, as the pinned bridge's own `_sigToIndex` does
`pinnedPlugins` and an inline `list.map(pinnedPlugin)` were two spellings of one map inside the same module
one array was renamed at four of five hops (`standardMaterialPlugins`, `standardLists`, `lists`, `pluginLists`); it is `standardMaterialPlugins` at every hop
`guardExcludes` carried an `===` arm no corpus scene reaches, in a module whose whole discipline is refusing the unreached by name; it refuses by shape instead

`StandardTextureSetters` and `lowerStandardTextureSetters` had already stopped being about textures when `uvTransform` joined them, and the plugin index was the second; renamed to `StandardMaterialSetters` with both doc comments refreshed

`MaterialRecord::plugin_signature_index` as a `uint32_t` grew the record by 8 bytes where a byte in the existing padding hole is free; the field is a `std::uint8_t`, sized to the pin's own 7-bit PLUGIN_INDEX_MASK, and generation refuses a mask that would not fit it
the plugin sweep arm doubles scene 217's composed Standard variant set, and one of the two added pairs is unselectable because its only Standard material carries the plugin
findings.blockedBy: the compiler keeps no count of Standard materials that took a `plugins` write against the Standard materials it created, which is the measurement that would prove the unattached sweep arm unselectable

findings.summary: `getCustomCode` is folded by a bespoke walker where `src/lowering/pinned-shader-text.ts` is already a general bounded evaluator for a TypeScript function returning shader text, and routing through it would widen the accepted slice for free
findings.blockedBy: `PinnedShaderText` is bound to pinned modules by (modulePath, symbolName) and fails through `contractError`, which carries a pinned source location; folding scene code through it needs a supplied-declaration entry point and an injectable failure sink, neither of which exists

findings.summary: a general `materialFamily` lane on `Value` would replace the boolean marker and also stop grid and shader materials silently taking Standard-only record writes through `enableMaterialUvTransform` and the texture setters
findings.blockedBy: naming the family at all five material creation sites, and refusing on it at every Standard-only record write, is a lane that does not exist yet; the propagation half this change needed is applied

findings.summary: the distinct-list-to-index registry (`recordStandardMaterialPlugins`) and the single-statement-of-a-branch read (`onlyReturn`) each exist in three to five places across the repository with no shared helper to call
findings.blockedBy: there is no shared home to call: the three registry copies key differently (module path, shader name, plugin key), so the shared form needs a key-function parameter and is an extraction across five unrelated modules
